caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a male human figure rendered in shades of brown and gold, giving the appearance of a bronze or wooden sculpture. The figure is shown standing on a round sphere with only the toes of the left foot touching the surface. The right leg is bent at the knee, slightly raised behind, and the left arm is lifted with the hand pointing upward. He is partly draped with a cloth that flows from the left shoulder across the back and around the right arm. The figure wears a winged helmet and winged sandals. The background is a plain, off-white color without any other objects or elements.
title: Wooden "Mercury" Figure
